name: Sortable List
description: A framework-free Web Component that lets a reader reorder rows in a list or a table, and move them between connected lists, by pointer or by keyboard. Built on pointer events rather than the HTML5 drag-and-drop API, which does not exist on touch.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Reordering by handle, the movement threshold, and the pointer path that also works on touch.

variants.name: Table
variants.description: The same component on real table rows, and the two things a table costs.

variants.name: Connected
variants.description: Moving rows between lists that share a group, by pointer and by keyboard, with the destination named out loud.

variants.name: Keyboard
variants.description: The second path in full, including the cancel that puts the row back where it started.

variants.name: Commit
variants.description: Saving the new order, holding while it is in flight, and going back when the server refuses.

variants.name: Markup
variants.description: The data contract, the no-script fallback, and auto-scrolling a long list inside a box.

variants.name: States
variants.description: Locked rows that act as walls, a single row, nothing at all, switched off, and a failure.
